{{Quote|There's nothing we can do. The Duchess' forces are being overrun across the entire planet.|The captain, reporting the state of the defense of Mandalore|<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>}}
By the year [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a certain '''Mandalorian police officer''' held a position of rank among his fellows. When the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], a large force of combined criminal gangs, [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attacked Mandalore]] this officer fought on the front lines.

==Biography==
This [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was present when the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] members first [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|attacked Mandalore]], coming to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in large crates. When a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] picked up life forms, this officer ordered it to stand back. Before he could approach one of the crates, however, they burst open and members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] and [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] leapt out. A Black Sun infantryman assaulted the captain, knocking him to the ground. The captain managed to inform his forces that the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari shipping docks]] were under attack before being rendered unconscious.
[[File:SundariDocksAssault-SOR.jpg|thumb|left|210px|The officer (right) is attacked by a member of the Black Sun]]

This officer later attempted to defend the bank of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] against the Shadow Collective. The majority of his men were quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], however, and he was later visible being locked into a crate along with civilians and one other officer at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari shipping docks]]. The [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] then arrived, defeating the criminals and freeing the people. When this officer thanked the [[Unidentified Death Watch soldier (white helmet)/Legends|ranking Death Watch member]], the latter replied that the captain should "thank [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]."

==Appearance==
The Mandalorian captain looked very similar to standard officers, wearing grey clothing underneath light body armor. He had a yellow insignia on his left shoulder and his helmet bore two small crests on top. His visor, unlike most officers', did not consist of two sections for the eyes. Rather, it was one large slit that covered both.
